description: Dept. of Fiscal Policy - Excise Duty on Liquor, w.e.f. 06.03.2019
categorisation: This gazette notification primarily concerns legal/regulatory matters as it announces new excise duty rates on various types of liquor through an Excise Notification issued under the Excise Ordinance. While it mentions Minister Mangala Samaraweera, it does not focus on his appointment or portfolio responsibilities, but rather on the regulatory changes to excise duties, making it a Legal/Regulatory gazette rather than a government personnel or hybrid classification.
